 🚀 SupportFlow CRM

 💼 Modern Customer Support Ticket Management System

A fullstack CRM platform built to streamline customer support operations through efficient ticket management, customer tracking, status monitoring, and team collaboration.


 🎯 Built for Datastraw AI + Tech Internship Assessment

A productionready Support CRM System designed to help support teams efficiently manage customer issues, track ticket lifecycles, and improve customer experience.

 ✨ Features

 🎫 Ticket Management

* Create support tickets
* Autogenerated Ticket IDs
* Timestamp tracking
* View complete ticket details
* Update ticket status
* Add notes and comments
* Customer issue history

 🔍 Smart Search & Filtering

* Search by Ticket ID
* Search by Customer Name
* Search by Email
* Search by Subject
* Search by Description
* Realtime filtering
* Statusbased filtering

 📊 Dashboard Analytics

* Total Tickets Overview
* Open Tickets Count
* In Progress Tickets Count
* Closed Tickets Count
* Ticket Status Distribution
* Ticket Activity Monitoring

 👥 Customer Management

* Customer Profiles
* Customer Ticket History
* Previous Interactions
* Customer Support Overview

 🎨 Modern UI/UX

* Responsive Design
* Mobile Friendly
* Professional SaaS Dashboard
* Interactive Tables
* Clean User Experience
* Modern Components
* Beautiful Analytics Cards



 🛠 Tech Stack

 Frontend

* React
* TypeScript
* Vite
* Tailwind CSS
* React Router
* Axios

 Backend

* Node.js
* Express.js
* REST API Architecture

 Database

* PostgreSQL

 Deployment

* Vercel (Frontend)
* Render (Backend)



⚡ Getting Started

Clone Repository
git clone https://github.com/rootdenied/SupportFlow.git
cd SupportFlow


Frontend Setup
npm install
npm run dev


Frontend will run on:
http://localhost:5173

Backend Setup
cd backend
npm install
npm run dev


Backend will run on:
http://localhost:5000


 🔐 Environment Variables
create .env file in backend folder and well as in frontend folder:
backend folder .env file:
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:<postgresql-password@localhost:5433/supportflow_crm"

PORT=5000
NODE_ENV=development

JWT_SECRET="supportflow-super-secret-key-change-in-production-2026"
JWT_EXPIRES_IN="7d"

GEMINI_API_KEY="API-KEY"

FRONTEND_URL="http://localhost:3000"

RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS=900000
RATE_LIMIT_MAX=100


Frontend .env file data:
DATABASE_URL="prisma+postgresql_string"
